title: terragucci.yml
description: One repo's settings, or a control repo's defaults and projects. https://intentius.io/terragucci/reference/config/

roots.description: Globs of root directories. Detected when absent.

backend_config.description: Root glob to the -backend-config file or files the root's init takes, relative to the root's directory.

var_files.description: Root glob to the -var-file file or files the root's plan takes, relative to the root's directory.

instances.description: A root directory to the names it runs under: each name is a root called <directory>@<name>.

binary.description: The binary the pipeline runs. Detected when absent.

version.description: The binary's release, or a map of root glob to release.

generate.description: Backend, provider and version files terragucci generate writes for each plain root.

forge.description: The forge, for a host terragucci cannot name.

url.description: Where the project lives, for a forge not on https or the default port. forge_url is the vocabulary's key for it.

forge_url.description: Where the project lives, for a forge not on https or the default port: the vocabulary's key for url, which stays accepted.

gate.description: When a wave waits for an approval. on-destroy is an older name for on-destructive.

mode.description: What counts as a waiting wave's approval.

require_signed.description: Refuse an unsigned approval on the ledger, so every ledger approval is tied to the principal who signed it.

approval.description: What counts as a waiting wave's approval: the mode, or a map with the mode and require_signed.

roots.description: Root globs: a wave with a root one matches takes the rule.

count.description: How many distinct people approve the wave's set digest. Default 1.

roles.description: Each approver counted holds one of these roles in .chant/trust.json at base.

not_author.description: At least one approver counted is not the change's author.

proven.description: Only approvers a seal or a review proves count toward count.

name.description: The rule's name, shown in its progress line, the plan note and the pending fact.

approval_rules.description: More approvers, or approvers with a role, for the waves whose roots a glob names.

locks.description: When a pull request takes its root locks: locks.when, or the value alone.

branches.description: The roots a branch applies, by glob: the vocabulary's key for apply.branches, which stays accepted.

waves.description: The canary wave, the jobs one wave spreads across, extra apply order, and whether a change's roots apply as one composed run.

drift.description: A cron schedule for tf-drift, drift.schedule, or false.

synth.description: The command that writes the roots before any job reads them.

image.description: The image every job runs in, built FROM terragucci's; as a map, its name, the provider mirror it carries and base, the set of terragucci's images (debian or chainguard).

notify.description: The secrets holding Slack, Teams or webhook addresses, the relay's name, and the secret holding the key its buttons are signed with.

cost.description: Cost estimates per root in the plan note.

comments.description: GitLab only: the cron of the comments schedule, or false.

watch.description: Module and provider globs whose newer releases start a rollout, with the bumps to follow and the age a release reaches first.

after.description: The earlier spelling of duration, still read.

conditions.description: The earlier spelling of checks, each condition a check that holds on a failure; still read.

overrides.description: Per module or provider glob: the first rule that names the rollout sets its wait, its conditions, or both.

soak.description: How long a wave applied before the next one opens, and the checks that must pass on its roots meanwhile, in the words of environments.<name>.soak.

rollouts.description: A cron schedule for the job that opens each rollout's next wave, or false; or a map of that schedule and the watch rules.

release.description: The dispatch carries the release digest the applied commit was cut into, so a downstream run reads that release's artifacts.

control.description: The control repo to tell after the default branch's apply succeeds; it runs this repo's dependents.

templates.description: Apps from templates: the registry whose catalog lists them, the path of a requested app's root, and the attestation a version needs.

gitlab.description: GitLab only: how the project keeps its forge token.

runtime.description: Where the stages run: forge, the forge's CI, or prow, ProwJobs on a Prow installation.

config_repo.description: The repository whose job config holds the jobs, when it is not this one.

path.description: Where init writes the job config. Default prow/terragucci.yaml.

cluster.description: The build cluster of the checks presubmit, which holds no credential. Default default.

trusted_cluster.description: The build cluster of the plan, apply and drift jobs.

service_accounts.description: The pods' service accounts on the trusted cluster: read-only for plan and drift, write for apply.

token_secret.description: The Secret on the trusted cluster with the GitHub token the jobs there post with.

plan_before_merge.description: A plan presubmit on the trusted cluster for pull requests from this repository.

deck.description: Deck's address, so the report and the notes link each job.

prow.description: With runtime: prow: the build clusters, the pods' service accounts, the token's Secret and where the job config goes.

reports.description: A bucket for plan reports: s3://, gs:// or az://.

token_env.description: The environment variable holding the forge token.

env.description: Environment variables every job gets. Values only, never secrets.

runner.description: The runner each job runs on: a label, a list of labels, a GitHub runner group, or one per stage.

pass.description: Names of CI secrets and variables the plan, apply and drift jobs get.

telemetry.description: The secret holding OTLP headers, and a trace link with {trace_id}.

identity.description: oidc: sign each release with the publish job's OIDC identity and no key.

issuer.description: The OIDC issuer the publish job's certificate names. With subject; both left out, the generated workflow's on GitHub and GitLab.

subject.description: The certificate's subject: the repository, the workflow file and the ref.

trusted_root.description: A sigstore trusted_root.json in the repo. Default .chant/trusted_root.json.

fulcio.description: Another Fulcio certificate authority than sigstore's.

timestamp.description: Another RFC 3161 timestamp authority than sigstore's.

identity.description: The identity the publisher signs keyless with, in place of key.

trusted_root.description: With identity: a sigstore trusted_root.json in this repo. Default .chant/trusted_root.json.

modules.description: Module publishing, attestation and the module registry.

oidc.description: Cloud identities the jobs take over OIDC: a read-only one for plan, a write one for apply. identity is the vocabulary's key for it.

identity.description: Cloud identities the jobs take over OIDC: the vocabulary's key for oidc, which stays accepted.

parallelism.description: How many roots of one dependency layer plan at once.

roots.description: Root globs: the entry covers a denial of a root one matches.

who.description: The forge identities or signers who may override such a denial.

roles.description: Roles in .chant/trust.json at base whose holders may override such a denial (approval: sealed).

rules.description: Only an override of these rule ids, every one of them.

agents.description: Forge app or bot identities that are agents; a change proposed through one has input.actor.kind agent.

sources.description: Globs of the module sources and provider addresses a root may use, checked before init, for every root or, as a map of root glob to those lists with a default, by root.

check.description: What tf-check runs beyond its own checks: the repo's pre-commit hooks.

identity.description: oidc: sign keyless from each job's OIDC token.

audience.description: With identity: the token's audience. Default sigstore.

runner_key_secret.description: The secret or CI/CD variable holding the runner key.

local.description: true: a check hook proven on a person's machine is skipped in CI.

evidence.description: The runner identity the jobs sign check evidence with: identity oidc, or runner_key_secret.

comment_allow.description: Who may run each comment command, beyond write access: logins and team:<org>/<team> entries per command, and default for the rest. Read from the default branch.

atlantis_comments.description: Read atlantis plan and atlantis apply comments as terragucci's.

respond.description: The response to each pipeline event.

login.description: The forge login agent.token_env's token acts as. No approval by it counts.

agent.description: The coding agent behind /terragucci agent, the drift agent, the agents that start from a production alert, a failed apply, a failed verify or soak, or a schedule, and the model behind respond.wave-refused: summary.

review.description: A model's review of each pull request's intent against its plan.

audit_region.description: The AWS region whose CloudTrail drift attribution reads.

audit_log_group.description: The CloudWatch Logs group a CloudTrail trail delivers the state buckets' S3 data events to; terragucci audit reads it to name who wrote a state version no wave or migration recorded.

dashboards.description: Dashboards and alert rules written next to the pipeline.

own_jobs.description: Jobs of your own, in the forge's syntax, or the path of a YAML file holding them.

ephemeral.description: Roots each pull request gets a copy of.

secrets.description: Values a root's binary gets from a cloud's secret store, fetched at job time with the root's own identity.

approval.description: The stage's approval mode, in place of approval.

approval_rules.description: The stage's approval rules, in place of approval_rules: count, roles, not_author, proven and name, and all or any groups.

hold.description: A manual hold: no release is promoted into the stage.

freeze.description: Freeze windows in which no release is promoted into the stage.

failure_tolerance.description: The failed runs a wave of many roots lets through before the stage stops: a number, or a share such as 10%.

after.description: The stages a release applies in before this one opens.

queue.description: replace: a newer release waiting replaces an older one.

urgent.description: The role whose one proven approval passes the stage's gate on an urgent promote.

pause_after_rollback.description: A rollback of the stage pauses it until it is resumed.

on_verify_fail.description: The stage's answer to a failed verify or soak check.

canary.description: The canary stage, whose soak holds every stage after it.

soak.description: How long the stage's soak checks must keep passing after its last apply before a release is promoted into the next stage.

publish.description: Release artifacts the stage publishes once it applied: { member, output } or { secret }.

reads.description: Artifacts of earlier stages the stage's deploy gets in a variable.

hooks.description: Commands the stage's waves run at before-observe, before-plan, after-plan, after-gate, before-apply or after-apply: each a command list with name, on_failure, per_run and targets.

agent_steps.description: Agent steps of the stage: prompt, schema, reads, command, key_secret, timeout, max_runs and max_cost_usd.

risk.description: The stage's risk threshold, and the approval rules an over score adds to its gate.

replan_dependents.description: The roots whose dependents are planned again when an output they read changes, in this stage.

config.description: Plain values the stage's jobs get as variables.

secrets.description: Secrets the stage's jobs get as variables, named by where each is kept.

imports.description: The config_sets the environment's set takes first, in order.

environments.description: Named environments: each one's root globs, and its gate, identities, apply runner, parallelism and forge environment, and the keys of its stage.

promotion.description: The order a release moves through the environments, first to last: names of environments, each once. With it, terragucci init and terragucci ci write .chant/pipeline.ts.

risk.description: risk.approve_above: the change risk score above which a wave needs an approval of its own.

replan_dependents.description: The roots whose dependents are planned again when an output they read changes after an apply.

config_sets.description: Shared sets of config and secrets that environments import.

release.description: Whether a merge cuts a release once the first stage applied, and its label.

recheck.description: The cron line a promotion a soak holds is tried again on.

defaults.description: Settings every project takes, under its own.
